title: PermDock CLI result v2
description: What a `permdock` command prints under `--json`, `--format json` or agent mode, following better-supabase's CLI contract 3 (`cli-result-v2`). A run that succeeds, or reports findings and exits 1, prints the result document on stdout. A run that fails prints the error document as one line on stderr and nothing on stdout. Fields are only added within v2.

status.description: `success` for exit code 0, `error` for a report that exits 1 (its findings are in `data`).

data.description: The command's report. Its shape is the command's own; a report with its own `$schema` keeps it.

warnings.description: Keys in the config file PermDock does not read, one line each.

next.description: Commands that move the run forward, in order.

status.description: `action_required` when a person has to give an input, confirm or log in, `error` otherwise.

reason.description: Why the run failed: a better-supabase CLI contract 3 reason, with its meaning and exit code.

type.description: The reason's heading on the errors page, `https://permdock.com/docs/cli/errors#<reason>`.

data.description: Details of the failure. Besides the members below, a reason may add its own, such as `files` for `file_conflict` or `status` for `request_failed`.

flag.description: The flag that supplies the missing or invalid value.

issues.description: One line per problem, such as `path: message` for invalid_input.

missing.description: The flags or `<positionals>` the run needs, for input_required.

choices.description: The values each missing flag or positional takes, the suggested one first.

digest.description: The value for --effects-digest once the user agrees, for confirmation_required.

effects.description: What the run would change, one line each, for confirmation_required.

command.description: A complete command line, starting with `permdock`.

argv.description: `command` as arguments, so a caller needs no shell parsing.

when.description: The condition under which to run it, such as `after the person agrees`.
